text:
sam: Seeing a ~20-35% tail latency bump on canary after the new kernel-picker. Quick triage below.
mira: ugh. which path—batching or kvcache?
sam: initial traces point at host parse + tokenizer time. grpc: read->parse->tokenize seemed to spike.
jon: can you paste perf flame or top stacks? :eyes: 
sam: paste:

```
# perf top sample (shortened)
1  parse_request_bytes
2  tokenize::byte_to_token
3  grpc::read_frame
4  kernel_selector::select_kernel
```

sam: The kicker: kernel selector is now checking sequence-length histogram sync on hot path which adds mem reads and a lock.
perfbot: ALERT: canary-group-7 95p latency +32% (2026-03-18 14:22 UTC) :warning:
mira: that explains the mem reads but why tokenize also worse?
jon: hypothesis: the extra mem ops push preparse CPU into higher cache-miss regime causing tokenizer slowdown.
sam: tried a local revert of the sync and tokenizer latency drops back to baseline.
nina: can we instead debounce the histogram update off the hot path? or use per-worker local sketches?
mira: agree—per-worker sketch updated async + periodic merge sounds promising.
jon: also batch heuristics: selector now forces smaller batch thresholds for certain models—could amplify overhead.
sam: timeline proposal:
- revert canary kernel-picker change for prod traffic (sam)
- implement per-worker async histogram + lockless snapshot (mira)
- add micro-bench for tokenization with and without mem-read scatter (jon)
- add grpc framing microtrace (nina)

mira: I'll open a PR for async sketch pattern and add a benchmark harness.
jon: I'll add a short reproducer script and a perf recording snippet: `perf record -g -F 99 -p <pid>`
sam: thanks. tagging @eng-oncall so we can roll back if rollout hits more customers :sam-roll:
perfbot: Incident template: https://internal/incident/flow - created incident 2026-03-18-1167
nina: for followup, let's also check KV cache eviction behavior. If selector change increases small batch count, kvcache churn could be higher.
mira: noted. adding KV cache metrics to the canary dashboards (eviction_rate, hit_ratio by model)
sam: OK, rolling back kernel-picker patch now. will update when rollback completed.
jon: create a short retro after fix. keep notes lightweight.
sam: rollback complete, early signals look good :thumbsup: 
perfbot: Monitor: 95p latency back within 5% of baseline for canary-group-7.

sam: thanks all — keeping thread open for bench results.
